goals.title: Deploy stage exits 0
goals.description: deploy_rc is the per-site deploy pipeline's exit code. Metric binding code-verified in run(); no recorded runs yet on this registration - first run will confirm.
directives: Never skip the smoke check after a deploy
On failure, include the failing stage's tail in the summary

goals.title: Test gate passes before every deploy
goals.description: test_rc must be 0 or the pipeline hard-gates. Metric binding code-verified; no recorded runs yet.
directives: Treat a red test gate as a full stop - no build/push/deploy stages run

goals.title: Post-deploy smoke check passes
goals.description: smoke_ok is boolean (1=pass); a deploy that fails smoke must roll back or alert. Metric binding code-verified; no recorded runs yet.
directives: A failed smoke check after a successful deploy is an incident, not a warning

goals.title: A red test gate repairs itself and the deploy goes out
goals.description: When the pre-deploy Playwright gate fails on code, the deployer's repair loop (deploy_repair + gate_runner, REPAIR.md) fixes it, re-tests and deploys without a human. gate_repaired is 1 on a run that turned a red gate green.
directives: Classify every red gate first: only code failures go to a repair session; infra failures are retried
Never ship a repair that weakens a test (skip/fixme/only, fewer expect() calls, deleted tests)
Escalate to the operator once a failure has exhausted a full repair cycle
